content.title: About
content.content: Seafood Sauce (1250) is a ready‑to‑use aromatic sauce made from tomatoes, fish stock, seaweed extract and spices. It is designed for quick preparation of dishes with fish, shrimp, mussels and other seafood, giving them a rich marine flavor and a mild heat.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The formula often includes seaweed extract, which contributes a distinctive umami taste.
The recipe is inspired by Mediterranean cuisine, where tomato‑based fish sauces have been used for over 500 years.
The sauce can be used not only in hot dishes but also as a marinade for cold seafood appetizers.
Natural flavorings help retain many of the beneficial trace minerals found in marine fish.

items.title: Rich in omega‑3
items.content: Contains fish oil rich in omega‑3 fatty acids, which support heart and vascular health.

items.title: Source of iodine
items.content: Seaweed provides iodine, essential for normal thyroid function.

items.title: Low in added sugar
items.content: Compared with many ready sauces, this product has minimal added sugar.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Provides vitamin B12 and other B‑vitamins important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Antioxidant properties
items.content: Tomatoes and spices supply lycopene and other antioxidants that protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Seafood allergy
items.content: The product may contain traces of fish, shellfish or shrimp, posing a risk for allergic individuals.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: The sauce has a moderate to high sodium level; people monitoring salt intake should use it sparingly.

items.title: Monosodium glutamate
items.content: Some versions contain added MSG; those sensitive to it should check the label.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Add the sauce to a pan with sautéed seafood, simmer with vegetables, or use as a base for soups and risotto. It can also be mixed with sour cream or yogurt to create a dip for seafood appetizers.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the sauce in a sealed container in the refrigerator at 2 °C–6 °C. Once opened, keep it for up to 7 days. Discard if the smell, color or texture changes or if mold appears.
